items.title: Solana’s plan for fairer trades stalls as block producers still choose which orders get in
items.whyYouShouldCare: The ongoing selection of orders by block producers could hinder Solana's goal for equitable trading, impacting user trust and ecosystem growth.

items.title: Pump.fun sells $5.83M SOL, but ETF inflows surge – Can Solana break $122.70?
items.whyYouShouldCare: The sale of $5.83M in SOL by Pump.fun contrasts with rising ETF inflows, indicating potential volatility and market interest in Solana's price movements.

items.title: Solana’s 150-millisecond settlement upgrade reaches second public test network
items.whyYouShouldCare: The successful testing of Solana's 150-millisecond settlement upgrade could enhance transaction efficiency, potentially attracting more users and increasing network activity.
